## Links

### News and analysis

- [PONARS Eurasia](https://www.ponarseurasia.org/): policy memos.
- [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en): independent news.
- [Riddle Russia](https://ridl.io/)
- [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/)

### Methods and tools

- [CRAN Task Views](https://cran.r-project.org/web/views/)
- [R Graph Gallery](https://r-graph-gallery.com/)
- [Statistical Modeling, Causal Inference, and Social Science](https://statmodeling.stat.columbia.edu/): Andrew Gelman's blog.
- [Connected Papers](https://www.connectedpapers.com/)

### For students

- [Writing Tips for PhD Students](https://www.johnhcochrane.com/research-all/writing-tips-for-phd-studentsnbsp): John Cochrane.
- [APSA eJobs](https://apsanet.org/careers/ejobs/)
